Hi everyone,

I am sorry for the short notice, but this Saturday's Algorithms Study
Group session (Session 4) is cancelled. The library has told us that its
discussion rooms will be closed on the evening of Saturday 31 October
for scheduled electrical maintenance.

We will cover the same problems in the next session on Saturday, 7

down any questions.

The attached calendar update removes the cancelled session from your
calendar.
